Based in Ephrata, Pennsylvania

Service Areas

American Clothing Restoration supports property owners, insurance adjusters, and restoration contractors with fire-, smoke-, and water-affected clothing and textiles. These approved communities are places where we welcome inquiries; actual pickup arrangements depend on the specific address, route, and scheduling.

Our planning area extends approximately 2 hours and 45 minutes by road from Ephrata. Listing a county does not mean every address in that county meets the estimated drive time.
